N34b.text: Where 1929 doesn't fit: by 1932 the Dow was down about 89% from its peak, and it took until 1954 to recover. This week was two bad days, so far.

N34c.text: In 1929, buyers put about 10% down; today's US rules require 50% for most margin purchases. And much of today's AI spending comes from very profitable companies, not small investors on credit.
